tldr: 中秋連假前台股量縮收黑，加權指數收48,025點、跌0.28%，台積電跌1%，惟其紐約ADR逆勢漲逾1%。
AI持續驅動半導體循環，SEMI看2030全球產值上看2兆美元、勤業眾信估2026營收9,750億美元創新高，台灣居核心。
壽險業趕在9月底前完成TIS資本申報大考，金管會給予過渡彈性；財富管理資金續流入，台灣拚區域資產管理中心。
美股在債市重挫、30年期公債殖利率升破5.5%創2004年來新高下仍收週線紅，油價因美伊停火預期走軟，亞股漲跌互見。
國內方面，主計總處上修2026成長率至11.05%、CPI突破2%，遺贈稅法修正同步上路。

items.title_zh: 中秋連假前台股量縮收黑、台積電走弱
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks slip before Mid-Autumn break as TSMC weakens
items.summary_zh: 台股在中秋連假前最後一個交易日開低走低，加權指數終場下跌132.7點、跌幅0.28%，收在48,025點，成交量縮至7,366億元，反映投資人在長假前調節持股。權值王台積電下跌25元、跌幅1.0%至2,475元，壓抑大盤表現。此波自歷史高點回落較像獲利了結，AI帶動的多頭趨勢尚未改變。
items.summary_en: In the last session before Taiwan's Mid-Autumn holiday, the TAIEX fell 132.7 points (-0.28%) to close at 48,025 on thinner turnover of NT$736.6bn, as investors trimmed positions ahead of the long weekend. TSMC dropped NT$25 (-1.0%) to NT$2,475, weighing on the benchmark. The pullback from record highs looks like profit-taking rather than a break in the AI-driven uptrend.

items.title_zh: 台積電ADR紐約收漲逾1%、折台股溢價明顯
items.title_en: TSMC ADR gains over 1% in New York, implying a premium to Taipei
items.summary_zh: 台積電美國掛牌ADR於9月24日上漲4.58美元、漲幅1.03%，換算約合台股每股2,867.51元，相對台北收盤價呈現明顯溢價。ADR走強主要反映市場對AI晶片需求的持續樂觀，也預示連假後台股恢復交易時，台積電本尊股價有機會獲得支撐。
items.summary_en: TSMC's US-listed ADR rose US$4.58 (+1.03%) on Sept 24, translating to about NT$2,867.51 per share and implying a sizable premium over its Taipei close. The strength, driven by continued optimism over AI-chip demand, points to potential support for the local shares when trading resumes after the holiday.

items.title_zh: SEMI總裁：2030全球半導體產值上看2兆美元、台灣是AI重鎮
items.title_en: SEMI sees global chip revenue hitting US$2 trillion by 2030, calls Taiwan an "AI powerhouse"
items.summary_zh: 在SEMICON Taiwan 2026半導體展上，SEMI總裁指出，在AI強勁需求驅動下，2030年全球半導體產值可望達到2兆美元，並稱台灣是實力堅強的AI重鎮、也是產業最值得信賴的夥伴。此一樂觀展望凸顯台灣在先進晶片供應鏈的核心地位，也為本土晶圓廠與半導體設備業者的中長期投資題材提供支撐。
items.summary_en: At SEMICON Taiwan 2026, SEMI's president said AI demand could push global semiconductor output to US$2 trillion by 2030 and described Taiwan as a highly capable AI hub and the industry's most trustworthy partner. The upbeat outlook underscores Taiwan's central role in advanced-chip supply chains and supports the multi-year investment case for local chipmakers and equipment suppliers.

items.title_zh: 勤業眾信：2026全球半導體營收上看9,750億美元創新高、AI晶片占半
items.title_en: Deloitte: 2026 global chip sales to hit record US$975bn, half from AI
items.summary_zh: 勤業眾信《2026全球半導體產業展望》預估，今年全球半導體營收將達9,750億美元、創歷史新高，其中生成式AI晶片營收接近5,000億美元，約占整體晶片銷售的一半。報告呼籲台灣企業掌握AI帶動的三大趨勢，反映AI晶片高度集中的成長動能，正重塑全球半導體競爭版圖。
items.summary_en: Deloitte's 2026 Global Semiconductor Industry Outlook projects worldwide chip revenue will reach a record US$975 billion this year, with generative-AI chips accounting for close to US$500 billion, about half of all sales. The firm urged Taiwanese companies to capture three key AI-driven trends, highlighting how concentrated growth in AI silicon is reshaping the competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: 壽險TIS資本首考 金管會祭兩招穩資本
items.title_en: Regulator eases capital rules as life insurers face first TIS reporting test
items.summary_zh: 面對9月底新一代清償能力制度（TIS）的首次資本申報大考，金管會給予監理彈性：旗下有壽險的8家金控可望獲得資本減壓，11家保險型金控則可延後一個月申報資本適足率。此舉旨在協助壽險業平順接軌新清償制度、降低資本不足衝擊，穩定市場對保險業財務體質的信心。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's FSC has granted supervisory flexibility ahead of the end-September deadline for the new Taiwan Insurance Capital Standard (TIS), the industry's first capital test. Eight financial holdings with life units get capital relief, while 11 insurance-focused holdings may defer their capital-adequacy filing by one month. The measures aim to smooth the transition to the new solvency regime and cut the risk of capital shortfalls.

items.title_zh: 金融監理趨嚴：11金控3保險9月底前強制申報TIS
items.title_en: Tighter oversight: 11 holdings and 3 insurers must file TIS by end-September
items.summary_zh: 在監理趨嚴下，11家金控與3家保險公司須於9月底前完成強制TIS申報，以市價衡量股市與匯市波動對資本的衝擊。此舉加深主管機關對保險業資產負債表韌性的檢視，也可能促使部分業者在申報期限前調整資產配置與避險部位，以因應市價評估帶來的資本壓力。
items.summary_en: Under stricter supervision, 11 financial holding companies and three insurers are required to complete mandatory TIS reporting before the end of September, measuring the impact of equity- and currency-market swings on a mark-to-market basis. The move deepens scrutiny of insurers' balance-sheet resilience and could prompt some players to adjust asset allocation and hedging ahead of the deadline.

items.title_zh: 高股息ETF續為焦點、2026績效榜出爐
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs stay in focus as 2026 performance rankings emerge
items.summary_zh: 台灣高股息ETF仍是追求穩定現金流投資人的核心持股，最新2026年績效榜依總報酬與配息率排出表現領先的基金。資金持續流入反映散戶對配息收益的強勁需求，不過分析師提醒，這類ETF成分股高度集中於少數AI相關個股，一旦回檔恐放大波動，投資人配置時仍須留意風險與適度分散。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's high-dividend ETFs remain a core holding for income-seeking investors, with the latest 2026 rankings highlighting the top performers by total return and yield. Continued inflows reflect strong retail demand for dividend income, though analysts caution that heavy concentration in a handful of AI-linked constituents can amplify volatility on any pullback.

items.title_zh: KPMG：台灣提前達陣資產管理規模目標、力拚區域資產管理中心
items.title_en: KPMG: Taiwan hits asset-management targets early, eyes regional-hub status
items.summary_zh: 根據KPMG《2026台灣財富管理趨勢報告》，台灣在2025年提前達成兩年期資產管理規模政策目標，為打造區域資產管理中心奠定基礎。報告指出，高資產客戶需求上升，加上信託、結構型商品、海外債與基金等產品線持續擴張，成為私人銀行與財富管理業務的主要成長動能，也吸引外商與本土銀行加碼布局高端客群。
items.summary_en: According to KPMG's 2026 Taiwan Wealth Management Report, Taiwan reached its two-year policy targets for asset-management scale ahead of schedule in 2025, laying a foundation to become a regional asset-management center. The report points to rising high-net-worth demand and expanding product shelves — trusts, structured notes, overseas bonds and funds — as key growth drivers for private banking.

items.title_zh: 遺產及贈與稅法修正上路、財政部整理四大重點
items.title_en: Amended estate and gift tax act takes effect with four key changes
items.summary_zh: 財政部正式公布《遺贈稅法》修正，四大重點包括：被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與特定親屬的財產須併計遺產課稅；計算配偶剩餘財產差額分配請求權扣除時，死亡前2年內贈與配偶財產視為現存財產；增訂遺產權屬案件的申報與核課期間起算規定；並放寬遺產稅分期繳納、允許繼承人以多數決動用遺產存款繳稅。修法一方面強化防杜避稅，另一方面增加繳稅彈性。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance has enacted amendments to the Estate and Gift Tax Act, adding rules that fold certain gifts to specified relatives within two years before death back into the taxable estate, adjusting the deduction for a spouse's remaining-property claim, clarifying the filing and assessment periods for estate-ownership cases, and easing installment payment by letting heirs use a majority vote to pay tax from estate deposits. The changes tighten anti-avoidance provisions while adding flexibility on payment.

items.title_zh: 2026贈與稅免稅額維持244萬、課稅級距隨物價調整
items.title_en: 2026 gift-tax exemption stays at NT$2.44m as brackets adjust for inflation
items.summary_zh: 2026年贈與稅免稅額維持每位贈與人244萬元，夫妻各自擁有額度、一年合計可免稅贈與488萬元；10%稅率級距上限為2,811萬元、15%級距上限為5,621萬元。遺產稅免稅額與各項扣除額維持不變，但課稅級距因CPI累計上漲12.42%達調整標準而調高，相對減輕高資產族群的稅負壓力，也為傳承規劃提供空間。
items.summary_en: For 2026, Taiwan's gift-tax exemption remains NT$2.44 million per donor, so a married couple can jointly gift up to NT$4.88 million tax-free a year. The 10% bracket now caps at NT$28.11 million and the 15% bracket at NT$56.21 million. Estate-tax exemptions and deductions are unchanged, but taxable brackets rose after CPI climbed 12.42% past the adjustment threshold, easing the relative burden on high-net-worth families.

items.title_zh: 主計總處上修2026經濟成長率至11.05%、CPI突破2%
items.title_en: Taiwan lifts 2026 growth forecast to 11.05% as CPI breaks above 2%
items.summary_zh: 主計總處大幅上修2026年全年經濟成長率至11.05%，創1988年以來新高，主要由AI帶動的出口與投資推升。同時將2026年CPI年增率上修至2.07%，正式突破2%通膨警戒線，中東情勢推升油價、氣候異常影響蔬果、AI需求墊高電腦設備價格，以及企業調薪反映至服務價格，皆為推手。高成長伴隨通膨升溫，使政策拿捏更趨兩難。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's statistics agency (DGBAS) has sharply raised its 2026 full-year GDP growth forecast to 11.05%, the highest since 1988, powered by AI-driven exports and investment. At the same time it revised the 2026 CPI inflation rate up to 2.07%, breaching the 2% alert line, as Middle East-driven oil prices, weather-hit produce, AI-related equipment costs and post-pay-rise service prices all pushed costs higher. The mix of red-hot growth and rising inflation complicates policy.

items.title_zh: 央行面臨升息抉擇、基準利率2%與美利差偏大
items.title_en: Central bank faces a rate dilemma with policy rate at 2% and a wide gap to the Fed
items.summary_zh: 在通膨升破2%之際，台灣央行在理監事會面臨艱難抉擇。目前基準利率為2%，明顯低於聯準會（Fed）3.50%～3.75%的目標區間，市場利率已提前反映預期而走高。分析指出，央行須在抑制通膨、維護成長循環，以及兼顧匯率與房市穩定之間權衡，才能決定利率政策方向，後續動向為市場關注焦點。
items.summary_en: With inflation pushing above the 2% line, Taiwan's central bank confronts a difficult call at its policy meeting. Its benchmark rate stands at 2%, well below the Fed's 3.50%–3.75% target range, and market rates have already begun to firm in anticipation. Analysts note the bank must weigh cooling inflation against protecting a growth cycle and managing exchange-rate and housing-market pressures before adjusting policy.

items.title_zh: 金價展望偏多、投行上調目標、中國持續買進
items.title_en: Gold outlook stays firm as banks lift targets and China keeps buying
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，投行對黃金看法轉趨樂觀，瑞銀（UBS）將目標價上調至每盎司6,200美元、摩根大通估2026年底上看6,300美元，主因各國央行需求強勁。中國今年來黃金進口累計突破1,000公噸，人行持續增持。短線而言，美元轉強與Fed升息預期升溫壓抑金價，但官方部門的結構性買盤，仍為金價中長期多頭提供支撐。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media report that investment banks have turned more bullish on gold, with UBS raising its target to US$6,200/oz and JPMorgan projecting US$6,300/oz by end-2026, citing strong central-bank demand. China's gold imports have topped 1,000 tonnes year-to-date and its central bank has kept adding reserves. Near-term, a firmer US dollar and rising Fed rate-hike expectations are capping prices, but structural official-sector demand underpins the multi-year story.

items.title_zh: 中東供應情勢改善、能源與通膨壓力趨緩
items.title_en: Middle East supply signs improve, easing energy and inflation pressure
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，海灣地區供應出現改善跡象：伊朗表示荷姆茲海峽最快可能於7天內重新開放，沙烏地阿拉伯也準備恢復延布港的原油出口作業。供應趨於正常化的預期，帶動國際油價明顯下挫，並緩和全球通膨疑慮，對台灣等仰賴進口的經濟體是一大利多；但分析師提醒，地緣停火仍脆弱，情勢一旦反轉，油價與通膨壓力恐再起。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese coverage notes tentative improvement in Gulf supply conditions: Iran has signalled the Strait of Hormuz could reopen within about seven days, while Saudi Arabia prepares to resume crude exports from Yanbu. The prospect of normalising flows has pulled international oil prices lower and tempered global inflation worries, a relief for import-reliant economies such as Taiwan, though analysts caution the geopolitical truce remains fragile and could reverse.

items.title_zh: 美股收復失土、以週線收紅作收（2026-09-25）
items.title_en: US stocks close out a volatile week with gains (2026-09-25)
items.summary_zh: 美股週五收高，為震盪的一週劃下正向句點。道瓊上漲478.64點、漲幅0.93%收51,828.62點，標普500漲0.51%收7,743.41點，那斯達克漲約0.5%收27,068.72點，股市擺脫公債遭大舉拋售的干擾，三大指數同步收出週線紅盤，顯示投資人風險偏好仍具韌性。
items.summary_en: Wall Street ended Friday higher, capping a bruising but ultimately positive week. The Dow rose 478.64 points (+0.93%) to 51,828.62, the S&P 500 added 0.51% to 7,743.41, and the Nasdaq gained about 0.5% to 27,068.72, as equities shrugged off a sharp Treasury sell-off. All three notched weekly wins.

items.summary_zh: 債市賣壓加深，美國30年期公債殖利率一度升破5.5%，創2004年以來新高。導火線是密西根大學消費者信心與通膨預期意外走高，加上Fed官員鷹派談話、美伊談判停滯，共同推升殖利率。10年期公債殖利率也升破5.2%、同創多年新高，反映市場對通膨與財政供給的疑慮升溫。
items.summary_en: A deepening bond sell-off pushed the US 30-year Treasury yield above 5.5%, its highest level since 2004, after a University of Michigan gauge showed consumer sentiment and inflation expectations rising. Hawkish Fed comments and stalled US-Iran talks added to the pressure. The 10-year yield also hit a fresh multi-year high above 5.2%.

items.title_zh: 油價震盪：美伊停火預期抵銷沙國供應風險（2026-09-25）
items.title_en: Oil wavers as US-Iran truce hopes offset Saudi supply risk (2026-09-25)
items.summary_zh: 原油價格週五上下震盪，市場一方面期待美伊達成停火，一方面又擔憂沙烏地阿拉伯遭攻擊、中東供應中斷風險再起。布倫特原油約在每桶105美元附近交易、西德州中級原油（WTI）約93美元，停火樂觀情緒與海灣緊張趨緩，整體壓抑油價漲勢，後市仍取決於地緣談判進展。
items.summary_en: Crude prices seesawed on Friday as markets weighed hopes for a US-Iran truce against renewed concern over attacks on Saudi Arabia and possible Middle East supply disruptions. Brent traded around US$105 a barrel and WTI near US$93, with truce optimism and easing Gulf tensions broadly capping gains.

items.title_zh: 亞股分歧：日經續漲、恆生走弱（2026-09-25）
items.title_en: Asian equities diverge: Nikkei extends gains, Hang Seng slips (2026-09-25)
items.summary_zh: 亞洲股市收盤漲跌互見，全球公債殖利率飆升考驗市場情緒。日本日經225指數上漲1.30%收66,364.20點，連五個交易日走高；香港恆生指數則下跌約1.0%收24,510.09點，為連三個交易日收黑。兩市表現分歧，凸顯資金在AI相關出口類股與對利率敏感的中港股之間輪動，投資人審慎看待殖利率走勢。
items.summary_en: Asian markets closed mixed as surging global bond yields tested sentiment. Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1.30% to 66,364.20, extending its winning streak to five sessions, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell about 1.0% to 24,510.09, its third straight decline. The split highlights rotation between AI-linked exporters and rate-sensitive Chinese equities.
